verdict.rationale: GrowthBook has a dedicated OpenFeature docs page. It states that switching to or from GrowthBook only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not any flag call, which is exactly the vendor-neutral flag code the story asks for. The evidence is a single first-party sentence with no further detail. missing for 10: which languages/runtimes have OpenFeature providers, provider feature-parity details (e.g. experiments, tracking hooks), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: Switching from or to GrowthBook only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not a single flag call.
